The session was well-structured, with clear explanations of key concepts that were easy to grasp for students. Dr. Nagraj's sir approach to teaching was interactive, encouraging participation and fostering a deeper understanding of civic sense and its importance in everyday life.

The use of real-world examples and relatable scenarios helped students connect the lessons to their own experiences, making the learning process both enjoyable and practical. Additionally, Dr. Nagraj’s sir patient and approachable manner made it comfortable for students to ask questions and express their thoughts.

Overall, it was a valuable learning experience, and I look forward to more such insightful sessions in the future.

Thank you sir!

Hello everyone myself Aarya P Revankar I am from samutkarsh Advanced course, recently I have joined advanced course, today was our first session, it was based on Public speaking🗣️,our Resource Person was Mrs Lata Hiremath She is soft skills trainer for many coperate company and she gives training for bank employees.
She gave us alot information about how we should speak in public,how our attitude should be while communicating with others,how much our body language matters,she said that according to scientists research 93%of body language is important while speaking only 7%Our speaking skills matters,and even fluency of english or the language you are speaking should be good,most important thing she said is you should have complete information about the the topic you are speaking never have half or incomplete information about anything,if you have whole information you don't feel nervous or insecure you will be more confident while speaking,and while speaking connection should be built with audience using eye contact,and always think twice before you speak something,we even had pick n speak and Debate the topic "AI is eating common man's job"
Today's session was so good, intresting,I learnt many new things and for sure I'm going to implement it in my daily life,I would be so happy if once again we would have session on Public speaking.
Thank you so much Lata mam and samutkarsh team for todays session.
